title: Selling the band and the memorabilia on the wall
summary: Humphrey says he always tried to sell whatever band he worked with and gives his best; he points to pictures, posters and letters on the wall.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: It's a natural thing for some people.

Do you find like there's a- Of course you have to give something too, you know what I mean. You have to give a performance. Like I try to, when I always did any band I worked with, I tried to sell the band. I tried to do my best to put it over. I give all I can and that's all you can do. If you like it, okay. You know what?
There's not much you can do.

There's one of the things that I do. See like that picture over there? That's what I get out there and do. Have you found- I guess you've seen all that because I guess you've come around, you've been around Jap because he wants to have stuff like that too. See all of that stuff they gave me over there?
Uh huh. Yeah. Mainly I notice all the posters up on the wall. Yeah.
We've got letters all back then.
